title: C² inverse function theorem with C² inverse on a neighbourhood (parent step 4, first item)
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^d be open, z₀ ∈ V, and let φ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d be of class C² on V with injective derivative Dφ(z₀) = fderiv ℝ φ z₀. Then there are open sets V₀, O ⊆ ℝ^d and a map g : ℝ^d → ℝ^d such that z₀ ∈ V₀ ⊆ V, g is C² on O, g maps O into V₀, φ(g(y)) = y for every y ∈ O, and φ(z) ∈ O and g(φ(z)) = z for every z ∈ V₀. (Thus φ : V₀ → O is a bijection with C² inverse g; in particular φ(z₀) ∈ O and g(φ(z₀)) = z₀.)
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (φ : Euclid d → Euclid d) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (z₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 φ V → Injective (fderiv ℝ φ z₀) → ∃ (V₀ O : Set (Euclid d)) (g : Euclid d → Euclid d), IsOpen V₀ ∧ IsOpen O ∧ z₀ ∈ V₀ ∧ V₀ ⊆ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g O ∧ MapsTo g O V₀ ∧ (∀ y ∈ O, φ (g y) = y) ∧ ∀ z ∈ V₀, φ z ∈ O ∧ g (φ z) = z
